intro: Thank you to the people, tools and open-source projects that made these apps possible. I try to say what each one actually did.
peopleFallback: A few friends, family members, lecturers and teammates helped with these apps. I will add their names here once I have asked each of them.

people.name: Friend who suggested RaGo Lens (name to add)
people.note: Suggested the idea for RaGo Lens and helped choose its name.

people.name: My family (names to add)
people.note: Supported me while I built these apps and tried them on their own phones.

people.name: Lecturers and mentors (names to add)
people.note: Taught me the foundations I build on and gave feedback on my work.

people.name: Teammates (names to add)
people.note: Worked on projects with me and taught me how to build as a team.

tools.name: Claude
tools.note: I plan my app ideas in conversation with Claude, an AI assistant made by Anthropic.

tools.name: Claude Code
tools.note: I build the apps with Claude Code, which writes and edits code in my repositories while I direct and review it.

tools.name: GitHub and GitHub Actions
tools.note: GitHub hosts the code and the releases, and GitHub Actions builds the signed APKs and this site.

communities.name: Open-source communities (to confirm)
communities.note: The maintainers and communities behind the libraries listed on the credits page.
